lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fourth floor, the desk by the third window. Your card is dead and the terminal is dark. The drawer is not locked, because nobody in the history of this building has ever locked a drawer.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My own file. Eleven years, four commendations, two certifications, and the note from the fourth year: asks too many questions about counterparties.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And an addendum underneath it, dated the day I ran, in a hand I do not recognise. QUERY ORIGINATED WITH SUBJECT. NO PRIOR REQUEST ON RECORD.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: They checked. Somebody sat down and checked whether I had been put up to it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Nobody asked me to look. That is what the addendum says and that is what frightened them. Two hundred and eighty-one years and nobody asked, and then I did, on my own, on a Tuesday, because the number was the wrong shape.
